scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bms/shared build && pnpm --filter @bms/db build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:onboarding && pnpm run test:schema
scripts.test:onboarding: pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/admin/onboarding/onboarding.schema.spec.ts && pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/security/credential-crypto.spec.ts && pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/admin/onboarding/onboarding-redaction.spec.ts && pnpm exec tsx apps/web/src/lib/onboarding-preview-auto-open.spec.ts && pnpm exec tsx apps/web/src/lib/admin-access.spec.ts && node apps/ingest/src/rtu-config.js
scripts.test:schema: pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/admin/admin.schema.spec.ts && pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/dashboard/dashboard.schema.spec.ts
